definitions.explanation: To make part of a total or group.

examples.japanese: {税金|ぜいきん}を{含|ふく}めて1000{円|えん}。
{私|わたし}を{含|ふく}めて5{人|にん}。

notes:
{含|ふく}める means to include or count something in a total.

TRANSITIVITY:
- Type: {他動詞|たどうし} (transitive)
- Related: {含|ふく}む (to contain, include - can be both transitive/intransitive)

KEY PATTERN:
〜を{含|ふく}めて: including ~

COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
- {税金|ぜいきん}を{含|ふく}めて: including tax
- {私|わたし}を{含|ふく}めて: including me
- {送料|そうりょう}を{含|ふく}めて: including shipping
- 〜を{含|ふく}めた{合計|ごうけい}: total including ~

DISTINCTION:
- {含|ふく}める: to deliberately include (active)
- {含|ふく}む: to contain (state) - e.g., この{食品|しょくひん}は{添加物|てんかぶつ}を{含|ふく}む (This food contains additives)
